```{r setup environment, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

library(yaml)
library(dplyr)

load_metpipe_runtime <- function() {
  package_mode <- tolower(trimws(Sys.getenv("METPIPE_PACKAGE_MODE", unset = "local")))
  if (!package_mode %in% c("local", "installed")) package_mode <- "local"

  if (identical(package_mode, "installed")) {
    if (!requireNamespace("metpipe", quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop("METPIPE_PACKAGE_MODE='installed' but package 'metpipe' is not installed")
    }
    library(metpipe)
    return("installed")
  }

  candidates <- unique(Filter(nzchar, c(
    Sys.getenv("METPIPE_LOCAL_ROOT", ""),
    "H:/Documents/CBMR_workflow/packages/metpipe",
    normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
    normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
    normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), "..", ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  )))

  is_pkg_root <- function(path) {
    dir.exists(path) &&
      file.exists(file.path(path, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
      dir.exists(file.path(path, "R"))
  }

  roots <- candidates[vapply(candidates, is_pkg_root, logical(1))]
  if (length(roots) == 0) {
    stop("Cannot locate local metpipe package root. Set METPIPE_LOCAL_ROOT to your metpipe folder.")
  }

  if (!requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("pkgload is required for local source loading. Install with install.packages('pkgload').")
  }

  Sys.setenv(METPIPE_LOCAL_ROOT = roots[[1]])
  pkgload::load_all(path = roots[[1]], export_all = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
  "local"
}

metpipe_runtime <- load_metpipe_runtime()

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,
  include = TRUE
)

```

# Global input
```{r}

path_raw = params$path_raw
path_result = params$path_result
path_workflow = params$path_workflow
path_mzmine = params$path_mzmine
path_temp = params$path_temp

```

# Workflow selection
```{r}

method_all <- readRDS(paste0(path_workflow, "/parameters/method_configuration.rds"))

method_name <- basename(path_raw)
matrix_i <- strsplit(method_name, "_")[[1]][1]
assay_i <- strsplit(method_name, "_")[[1]][2]
analysis_i <- strsplit(method_name, "_")[[1]][3]

method <- subset(method_all, assay == assay_i & analysis == analysis_i)

```

# Raw data files
```{r}
path_files_pos <- paste0(path_raw, "/pos/")
path_files_neg <- paste0(path_raw, "/neg/")

run.pos <- FALSE
run.neg <- FALSE
raw_files_pos <- NULL
raw_files_neg <- NULL
meta_pos <- NULL
meta_neg <- NULL

qc_types = c("BL", "NIST", "PO", "sol", "CP", "IQ", "BPL", "MMix")

if (dir.exists(path_files_pos)){
  run.pos <- TRUE
  raw_files_pos <- list.files(path_files_pos, full.names = TRUE, pattern = ".d$|.mzML")
  meta_pos <- 
    map_standard_name_to_meta(raw_files_pos,
                              qc_types = qc_types) 
}

if (dir.exists(path_files_neg)){
  run.neg <- TRUE
  raw_files_neg <- list.files(path_files_neg, full.names = TRUE, pattern = ".d$|.mzML")
  meta_neg <- 
    map_standard_name_to_meta(raw_files_neg,
                              qc_types = qc_types) 
}


```

# mzmine input
```{r}

#path_result <- gsub("raw", "peaktable", path_raw)
mzmine_params <- paste0(path_workflow, method$mzmine_params)
path_lib_istd_pos <- ifelse(!is.na(method$path_lib_istd_pos), paste0(path_workflow, method$path_lib_istd_pos), NA)
path_lib_istd_neg <- ifelse(!is.na(method$path_lib_istd_neg), paste0(path_workflow, method$path_lib_istd_neg), NA)
# path_lib_pos <- ifelse(!is.na(method$path_lib_pos), paste0(path_workflow, method$path_lib_pos), NA)
# path_lib_neg <- ifelse(!is.na(method$path_lib_neg), paste0(path_workflow, method$path_lib_neg), NA)
spectral_lib <- strsplit(method$path_spectral, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
path_spectral_lib <- paste0(path_workflow, spectral_lib)
mzmine_user <- paste0(path_workflow, "/parameters/qiangao.mzuser")
mzmine_memory <- "-memory none"
mzmine_threads <- "-threads auto"
```

# QC
```{r}
figure_height = 800
figure_width = 1000

```

# post processing
## Clean peaktable
```{r}

mean.filter <- list(c( 2, "BL", "<", "PO"),
                   c( 1, "Sample", ">", 500))
rsd.filter <- list(c(1, "PO", "<", 0.3))
rt.range <- c(0, 30)
filter_by_missing_feature_pct <- 50
filter_by_missing_sample_type <- "Sample"
outliers.sample <- c()
clean.po.sample.to.use <- "PO"

```

## Normalization
```{r}

impute.method.sample <- "HF"
impute.method.is <- "HF"
norm.po.sample.to.use <- "PO"
norm.method <- c("bestis", "low_cv", "sum", "median")
sample.type.keep <- c("NIST", "PO")

```

## Merge and map info
```{r}

final.norm <- "bestis"
final.eval.sample.to.use <- "PO"
final.sample.type.keep <- c("Sample", "PO", "NIST")
```

## Others
```{r}

mzmine_peaktable_pos <- paste0(path_result, "/pos/pos_full_feature_table.csv")
mzmine_peaktable_neg <- paste0(path_result, "/neg/neg_full_feature_table.csv")
path_peaktable_pos <- paste0(path_result, "/peaktable_pos.xlsx")
path_peaktable_neg <- paste0(path_result, "/peaktable_neg.xlsx")
path_peaktable_istd_pos <- paste0(path_result, "/peaktable_istd_pos.xlsx")
path_peaktable_istd_neg <- paste0(path_result, "/peaktable_istd_neg.xlsx")
if (!dir.exists(paste0(path_result, "/data"))) dir.create(paste0(path_result, "/data"))
rds_qc_is_pos <- paste0(path_result, "/data/QC_IS_pos.rds")
rds_qc_is_neg <- paste0(path_result, "/data/QC_IS_neg.rds")
rds_datalist <- paste0(path_result, "/datalist.rds")
path_datatable <- paste0(path_result, "/datatable.xlsx")
```

# Generate yml
```{r}

config <- list(

  path_lib_istd_pos = path_lib_istd_pos, 
  path_lib_istd_neg = path_lib_istd_neg,  
  path_spectral_lib = path_spectral_lib,  
  figure_height = figure_height,
  figure_width = figure_width,  
  mean.filter = mean.filter,
  rsd.filter = rsd.filter,
  rt.range = rt.range,
  filter_by_missing_feature_pct = filter_by_missing_feature_pct,
  filter_by_missing_sample_type = filter_by_missing_sample_type,

  clean.po.sample.to.use = clean.po.sample.to.use,
  impute.method.sample = impute.method.sample,
  impute.method.is = impute.method.is,
  norm.po.sample.to.use = norm.po.sample.to.use,
  norm.method = norm.method,
  sample.type.keep = sample.type.keep,

  final.eval.sample.to.use = final.eval.sample.to.use,
  final.sample.type.keep = final.sample.type.keep,  
  
  raw_files_pos = raw_files_pos,
  meta_pos = meta_pos,
  raw_files_neg = raw_files_neg,
  meta_neg = meta_neg,
  # path_lib_pos = path_lib_pos,

  spectral_lib = spectral_lib,
  mzmine_user = mzmine_user,
  mzmine_memory = mzmine_memory,

)

cat(yaml_str)
writeLines(yaml_str, paste0(path_result, "/config.yml"))
```
